_comment: Written by the trading runs. impliedMove is a decimal or null. null means the straddle was not pulled - an open checklist item, not a placeholder to guess at. This file is a list of what is AHEAD: the pre-close run prunes catalysts once their date has passed and re-reads spot from a live quote, because a reference price carried from the day it was written makes every implied range wrong.
prunedNote: Pre-close prune. Nothing removed and nothing added, which is the right outcome rather than a skipped step: the file holds one row, SMCI on 8/11, and 8/11 is still ahead. The date check was run against every row rather than assumed from the last prune - the 11:57 open run had already removed the three landed catalysts (the SMR 8/14 expiry, which was a clock on a position the account no longer holds; MARA and OKLO, both spent prints), so there was no passed date left to catch. The work this run actually did is the spot re-read, and it was overdue. SMCI's spot has been 30.80 since 11:57 while the name traded to 31.22 at 15:22 and 30.94 now - a drift that reached 1.4% intraday and would have made any implied range struck off this row wrong in the direction that flatters it. It is now the live 15:35 bid. The calendar itself was re-verified against the broker rather than carried: 8/11, timing pm, verified true, estimate 0.69, no actual. The forward calendar was also swept for the other eleven watched names and none has a catalyst in the window - every 8/4 to 8/7 print on this board has landed - so SMCI is the only row this file should contain, not merely the only one left over. impliedMove stays null and stays an open item rather than a moot one: the account is flat with 109.88 of settled cash, so an entry here is affordable, which means item 3 is the thing standing between this name and a position rather than the balance being it.

moves.source: Re-verified on the live broker earnings calendar at 15:35 ET on 8/7: timing 'pm', verified true, estimate 0.69, no actual. spot is the live bid at 15:35 ET on 8/7, replacing the 30.80 struck at 11:57 - the same re-read this row got at the open, done again because the name moved 1.4% between the two and a reference price is only worth carrying for one session. This is the only catalyst ahead of the account on any watched name, confirmed by sweeping the forward calendar rather than by elimination. The account goes into the weekend flat, so nothing is held into this print and no decision is owed before Monday; what is owed on Monday is the straddle.

branches.cond: Any entry considered on 8/10 or later
branches.act: Pull the at-the-money straddle and write the implied move down before sizing
branches.why: A five-session hold opened Monday runs through the 8/11 print, so the print is inside the hold and item 3 binds without exception. Holding through a report is a coin flip on the implied move, taken deliberately with the number written down or not taken at all. No straddle pulled means no earnings hold - that is the rule, and it is why this row survives every prune while the landed ones do not.

branches.cond: An option is considered on this name
branches.act: Refused outright while the hold would cross 8/11
branches.why: The rulebook forbids holding an option through a print. IV crush kills even a correct call, and a 3-6 week expiry from here necessarily spans 8/11. An option on SMCI is not available to this rulebook before the print regardless of what the straddle says.

branches.act: Close it, or write the hold down with the implied move attached
branches.why: An equity hold through a print gets pre-decided with the number in hand or it does not happen. The decision belongs to the 8/11 pre-close run, which is the last one that sits between the position and the report.
